title: Exploring the Unfairness of DP-SGD Across Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring fairness metrics (δ-Unequal Risk and modified p%-rule) by comparing F1-scores in toxicity classification models trained with differential privacy across male and female identity groups.
Measuring fairness metrics (δ-Unequal Risk and modified p%-rule) by comparing F1-scores in toxicity classification models trained with differential privacy for comments targeting the LGBTQ community.

Measuring fairness metrics (δ-Unequal Risk and modified p%-rule) by comparing F1-scores in toxicity classification models trained with differential privacy across Christian, Muslim, and other religious identity groups.

Measuring fairness metrics (δ-Unequal Risk and modified p%-rule) by comparing F1-scores in toxicity classification models trained with differential privacy across Black and White racial identity groups.
